subject: Lumenix vendor kickoff: payment details & invoice/remit preferences
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <accounts@lumenix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumenix vendor kickoff: payment details & invoice/remit preferences

Hi Marta —

Welcome, and thanks for partnering with Redwood. I’m kicking off the vendor setup for Lumenix so we can get you in our AP system and set payment preferences. To keep things moving, could you please: 

- Complete the attached vendor onboarding form (Lumenix_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf).
- Return your W-9 (if US entity) and a bank letter or voided check for bank verification (W9_Lumenix.pdf and Lumenix_bank_letter.pdf are fine if attached).
- Confirm whether you prefer ACH or wire (ACH is our default and preferred method to avoid intermediary fees). If wire is required, please confirm if you expect Redwood to cover receiving bank fees.
- Provide the remittance email you want Redwood to send payment notifications to (e.g., remit@lumenix.com).
- Confirm invoice submission method: we support (a) vendor portal upload, (b) invoices@redwood-invoice.com, or (c) emailed PDFs to your Redwood account rep. Please state which you prefer and any PO number format we should expect on your invoices.

A couple of notes on our side:
- Redwood requires PO numbers on invoices for PO-matched payments. Invoices without a PO may be delayed.
- Our standard payment terms are net 30 from invoice date after three-way match (PO + goods receipt + invoice). We can discuss net 45 for first orders if needed, but that requires approval by finance.
- For bank verification we can either: (1) accept a bank letter plus W-9, or (2) send a secure DocuSign envelope to collect bank info and verify via micro-deposit. I’ve included a DocuSign link below if you prefer the secure flow.

Attaching vendor onboarding instructions as well (vendor_onboarding_instructions.pdf).

If you can return the form and bank docs by EOD next Wednesday (18 Feb) we’ll aim to have you in the system for the first payment run on the 28th.

Thanks — feel free to loop in Diego or your finance contact.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We completed the onboarding form and attached our W-9 and bank letter (attached: W9_Lumenix.pdf, Lumenix_bank_letter.pdf). A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Preferred payment method: Wire is our preferred method as it posts immediately to our treasury partner. We can accept ACH but we typically pass inbound ACH fees to the payor. Is Redwood willing to absorb wire-related beneficiary fees, or would you prefer ACH to avoid fees?
- Remittance email: please send remittance advices to remit@lumenix.com and CC diego.ramos@lumenix.com. We need the remittance to include PO number and invoice number.
- Invoice submission: we can upload invoices to your vendor portal if you send the onboarding link; otherwise we’ll email invoices@lumenix.com and CC invoices@redwood-invoice.com per your guidance.

We uploaded the completed onboarding form to the DocuSign link you provided and also attached the files to this reply. If you prefer the micro-deposit verification instead of a bank letter, let us know and we can start that flow.

Thanks —
Marta Ruiz
Accounts Payable Manager
Lumenix Supplies
accounts@lumenix.com

Attachments: W9_Lumenix.pdf, Lumenix_bank_letter.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <accounts@lumenix.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix vendor kickoff: payment details & invoice/remit preferences

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple of points to confirm from Finance: 

- Payment method: Redwood’s preferred method is ACH (lower cost and faster reconciliation). We can pay via wire for the initial runs if Lumenix requires it, but Redwood does not typically reimburse beneficiary bank fees unless it’s in the negotiated commercial terms. If you require wires for all payments, please flag that to your Sales contact (Ben) so we can route to Procurement for approval of fee coverage.

- Terms: Standard is NET 30. For an initial exception to NET 45, Procurement and Finance require written approval; Ben, can you confirm if the deal paperwork supports a 45-day term here?

- Invoice submission + remittance: Please send invoices with the PO number in the invoice number or invoice header. Preferred invoice paths are: (1) upload to our vendor portal (link: https://drive.google.com/redwood-onboarding/lumenix for onboarding docs and portal invite), or (2) email invoices@redwood-invoice.com (this address routes directly into our AP queue). Remit advices should go to remit@lumenix.com and we will send payment advices to that address when a payment is issued. Remittance emails must include: Redwood PO#, Redwood Invoice#, payment amount, payment date, and payment method.

- Bank verification: We will accept the bank letter you provided, but for final approval we ask that you either (a) confirm deposit account name exactly matches W-9, or (b) complete the DocuSign micro-deposit flow (https://app.docusign.com/embedded/12345678). The micro-deposit is the fastest path to activate ACH.

Next steps:
- Marta: please confirm whether you want initial payments via wire (we can arrange) or to proceed with ACH and micro-deposit.
- Ben: please confirm approvals for any non-standard payment term (NET 45) or any wire fee coverage.

Thanks — we’ll hold onboarding completion until we have that confirmation.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Hi Laura and team —

Thanks for the clarification. Lumenix will proceed with the ACH micro-deposit verification today (we completed the DocuSign envelope) to enable ACH going forward. For the initial invoice run, we request wire for the first two payments due to treasury cutoffs; we do not expect Redwood to reimburse incoming bank fees for subsequent runs.

We have confirmed remit@lumenix.com as the remittance email and will include PO numbers on every invoice. We’ve uploaded the invoices to the portal and also emailed invoices@redwood-invoice.com as a backup.

Happy to proceed on those terms — please confirm once the vendor record is active and when we can expect the first payment window.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
